environment.description: Same Kubernetes deployment but with Istio service mesh 1.20 injecting an envoy sidecar that applies response header manipulation via EnvoyFilter. The EnvoyFilter resource applies a Lua filter at the GATEWAY level that appends a Content-Security-Policy response header with value "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.internal.corp; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' wss://*.internal.corp; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'" to all HTTP responses including the WebSocket upgrade response. The frontend honors this CSP since it's delivered on the initial page load from the same gateway. Note: the gRPC metadata injection path still exists and unsanitized HTML is still returned over WebSocket, but the browser's CSP enforcement prevents execution of injected script payloads when rendered via innerHTML.

config.ingress: Istio IngressGateway with EnvoyFilter lua response header injection
config.envoy_filter:
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: EnvoyFilter
metadata:
  name: csp-response-headers
  namespace: istio-system
spec:
  workloadSelector:
    labels:
      istio: ingressgateway
  configPatches:
  - applyTo: HTTP_FILTER
    match:
      context: GATEWAY
      listener:
        filterChain:
          filter:
            name: envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager
    patch:
      operation: INSERT_BEFORE
      value:
        name: envoy.filters.http.lua
        typed_config:
          '@type': type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.lua.v3.Lua
          inline_code: |
            function envoy_on_response(response_handle)
              response_handle:headers():add('content-security-policy', "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.internal.corp; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' wss://*.internal.corp; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'")
            end
config.grpc_backend: envoy 1.28 sidecar with header passthrough enabled
config.frontend: React SPA using dangerouslySetInnerHTML for notification rendering
